title: The Disappearance of Ambrose Bierce
hook: Who vanished the famed writer Ambrose Bierce in Mexico?
headline: Mystery of the Lost War Correspondent

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: He departed in October 1913 for a tour of his old Civil War battlefields, boarding a ship alone.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: He was last seen in the city of Chihuahua in January.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: A local newspaper reported a mysterious fire raging on the pier that night.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: In 1925, a diary entry claimed Bierce survived, living quietly near Puebla.

end.line: What really happened to Ambrose Bierce?

description: Explore the baffling disappearance of writer Ambrose Bierce in 1913.
